title: Record Step Read Exit
statement: Given stored record data with state in an optional state type, a width-one flag, and other record fields, the resulting control state is the sweep phase for clearing the halting case if the state is absent. Otherwise, if the width-one flag is true, it is the sweep phase for clearing the empty case; if neither condition holds, it is the forward scan phase at the fuel stage.
